event.root_cause: The MEP services were routed in a Level 02 service zone that ignores the 1000 mm deep transfer girder on grid 3. Because the duct, tray and pipe all run straight through the solid web instead of at their preformed web openings, each one clashes with the girder, including the pipe clash missed by the Navisworks report.
event.reason: Lift each service to its designated web opening with 25 mm clearance - duct +0.375 to +0.425 m, tray +0.225 to +0.275 m and pipe +0.252 to +0.308 m including the unreported pipe - keeping all services clear of the girder and each other.

items.label: IfcDuctSegment 'Supply air main L02 600x300' x IfcBeam 'Transfer plate girder 1000 deep - grid 3'
items.understanding: The 600x300 supply duct runs straight through the solid web of the 1000mm deep transfer girder with 150mm overlap. Structure must stay, and a preformed web opening 7.38-7.78m exists just above for this duct. Lifting the duct locally puts it through the opening with clearance.

option.title: Offset duct up 400mm through web opening
option.rationale: Middle piece clears girder by passing through designated opening with 25mm all round.
option.also_needs: 4 x 90deg bends / 2 risers, re-hang middle piece

alternatives.title: Lift full duct run 400mm
alternatives.rationale: Whole run through opening if ceiling void allows, avoids offsets but disturbs longer run.
alternatives.also_needs: re-hang run, check connections at both ends and ceiling clearance

items.label: IfcCableCarrierSegment 'Cable tray L02 300x100' x IfcBeam 'Transfer plate girder 1000 deep - grid 3'
items.understanding: The 300x100 cable tray runs straight through the solid web of the 1000 deep transfer girder. Structure stays; the girder has a preformed opening at z 7.05-7.25m for this tray that the straight route misses.

option.title: Offset tray up 250mm through web opening
option.rationale: Lifts only the middle piece at the girder into its designated opening with 25mm clearance all round, leaving the long run at level.
option.also_needs: 4 x 90deg bends and 2 short risers, hangers adjusted at offset

items.label: IfcPipeSegment 'Cold water main L02 DN54' x IfcBeam 'Transfer plate girder 1000 deep - grid 3'
items.understanding: Cold water main DN54 runs 16.1 m straight through the solid web of the 1000 mm deep transfer girder, overlapping by 400 mm. Structure must stay, and the girder has a preformed opening on this line at z 7.10-7.26 m. The fix must lift the pipe locally to thread that opening with clearance.

option.title: Offset pipe up 280 mm through web opening
option.rationale: Lifts middle piece to z 7.18 m centre, centred in 7.10-7.26 m opening with ~50 mm clearance, clearing solid web with margin.
option.also_needs: 4 x 90-degree elbows and 2 short risers, none to structure
